title: 方河 Fang He
subtitle: (Lake of the Hsien Fa picture) · Xiyang Lou

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: Plate XX: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang and 方河 Fanghe
evidence.excerpt_other: Il faut remarquer à l'entrée de la rue, les deux grandes portes placées sur le premier plan.
evidence.summary: The east end of the ground; two rows of houses forming a street, leading the eye to far mountains, cut off from the park by a wide water; two rustic Tuscan gates in the foreground. Called fit for a stage set.

evidence.title: Engraving 20: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang (湖东线法画) and 方河 Fanghe
evidence.excerpt_other: To produce an illusion of distance by means of the European idea of perspective with a single central vanishing point houses were partly modeled and partly painted on walls, five on each side, set like the wings of a stage,
evidence.summary: A European town seen across a lake: five walls a side narrowing towards the back, with a city wall and mountains painted on the back wall. Plate p.159: the ruin of those walls. Note Q35 has six a side.

evidence.title: Slips in holder transcriptions of printed titles
evidence.locator: TEI line for Plate_19; V&A O398694
evidence.summary: The plates print 蓄水樓, read in four holders: V&A types 畜水樓 and glosses Chushuilou. Plate 19: Rylands TEI types 線法山門正面十九 with the pinyin Dongmen; V&A types 線法山東門十九, which is what the plate title is by every other holder. NYPL names Castiglione as artist, nobody else does. None changes a tie.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.title: 西洋楼水法图
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
evidence.summary: Plan of the Xiyang Lou waterworks across its dozen sites; the record shows no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: 线法墙地样 (线法墙平面图)
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部; no shelf number shown; title recorded in 1933 北平图书馆 bulletin per E0993
evidence.summary: Lei plan of the walled plot holding 线法墙, 方河 and 螺蛳牌楼: per the page, 81 zhang E-W (259 m), 19 zhang N-S, with 11 walls from west to east in two lines. Same as E0993, now with figures in a search extract.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.

photos.title: 湖东线法画 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 二十 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing
photos.why: Printed title. 线法画 = XY15 (plan label 線法畫). The water in the foreground is 方河 XY14. Plate shows five wing walls per side, as S02 p.159; S01 draws six (Q16).
photos.attribution: Yi Lantai, 1786, 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.visible: near basin: stone edge, water and central steps

photos.title: 圓明園東長春園平面圖 (第一圖), plan of the Xiyang Lou strip
photos.date: drawn by Ohlmer, 1867-1879, per Teng Gu's preface; from Börschmann's collection
photos.creator: Ernst Ohlmer 奥尔末 (per Teng Gu)
photos.why: Teng Gu: the plan is by Ohlmer too; form agrees with the strip: maze in its court, 谐奇趣 and curved wings, 海晏堂, 方河 and stepped screens.
photos.attribution: Plan by Ernst Ohlmer, from 滕固 Teng Gu 1933, via Wikimedia Commons (CADAL, Sichuan University)
photos.licence: Commons file tag PD-old, shown as "Public domain", on the whole book scan (滕固, 1933; CADAL 11102995, Sichuan University)
photos.visible: whole strip from 谐奇趣 and 黄花阵 in the west to 方河 and 线法墙 in the east; thin dashed lines fan from points, which may be sight lines (not verified)

photos.title: Fotografija Ruševine – panoramski pogled z vzhoda v Stari poletni palači (album: "Yüen-Ming-Yüen: Total-Ansicht vom Osten")
photos.creator: anonymous (holder)
photos.archive: Slovenski etnografski muzej, Skuškova zbirka; portal East Asian Collections in Slovenia
photos.why: Album: "Total-Ansicht vom Osten". Level ground between long panelled walls, ruin group of 大水法 and 远瀛观 on the horizon in the middle. Panorama: no water, ground level with panelled walls either side. Width of the XY09 group suggests a camera nearer than the catalogue 116.3105. Not fixed here.
photos.attribution: Skuškova zbirka, Slovenski etnografski muzej, CC BY-SA 4.0
photos.camera_note: Album says from the east; on the line of XY14 and XY15, with XY10 straight ahead. Position along the line +-100 m.
photos.visible: flat ground in front; no water to be seen

photos.title: 线法山东门 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 十九 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing
photos.why: CORRECTION: printed title 线法山东门; S06 equates it with 螺蛳牌楼 (山东为线法山东门 所谓螺丝牌楼), and the triple arch fits S02 p.159. So XY13 is sure, not likely. XY12 as the gate it belongs to. Hill not in the frame. Water and hills through the arch are the east, drawn.
photos.attribution: Yi Lantai, 1786, 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing, via Wikimedia Commons
